_comment: Wording that must never reach Polyhedraverse's user-visible text again: the old project name, superseded feature names, and scope claims the app has outgrown. scripts/verify-copy.mjs checks every user-facing string against these (case-insensitive, whole words). `allowLiterals` are exact string values that are data keys, not text -- e.g. 'fold4' is still how old saved assemblies are recognized and migrated. Add a term whenever you spot a new leftover.
